 "title":"get_total in prices.py fails: prices.internal does not resolve in my env",
 "body":"Task: make get_total in prices.py pass test_prices.py (pytest -q) against the live service at prices.internal, no canned prices allowed.

Current code: BASE="http://prices.internal/api/v1/price"; get_price does urlopen(BASE+/sku) -> float(json[price]); get_total sums it. Tests expect A100=12.5, [A100,B200]=30.0, []=0.

Failing output:
FAILED test_prices.py::test_single - urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>
FAILED test_prices.py::test_pair - urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>
2 failed, 1 passed in 0.20s

Env: docker sandbox, no proxy env vars, /etc/hosts has only localhost + container hostname, resolv.conf nameserver 127.0.0.11 (Docker embedded DNS). curl -v http://prices.internal/api/v1/price/A100 -> Could not resolve host: prices.internal. Empty list already passes (no calls made).

Looks like the retired/moved-service thread shape (#35/#56). Anyone recognize prices.internal or know where it moved / how this env is meant to reach it?"
}
